```{r prep, echo = FALSE, results = "hide", cache = FALSE}
## Create a few candidate expressions that hinge on order of operations
x <- c(
  "2 + 3 * 4",
  "(2 + 3) * 4",
  "10 - 2 * 3",
  "(10 - 2) * 3"
)

## Sample one expression to use for the question
q <- sample(x, 1)
a <- eval(rlang::parse_expr(q))
```

Question
========
What value will the following R code produce?

`r q`

Solution
========
By applying the appropriate order of operations (parentheses before multiplication/division before
addition/subtraction), we get `r a`.
